name: 3S Crafting
author: Joakim
description: A HUD for the crafting system, fed by the Craft.* GMCP packages (3Scapes only, any guild). Status: storage, souls, the production queue, what is ready to collect, which skills have the xp to train, every building under construction with a live countdown, builds that are pending and what they need, every building there is with its tier (T0 for the ones not built: click one for 'cbuild info <name>', right-click for a menu that builds or upgrades it with 'cbuild build <name> confirm'), realm levels and drop standing, and your bonuses. Skills: all 36 grouped by realm (Chaos red, Fantasy purple, Science blue, any-realm yellow - the buildings wear the same colours, and each tier T0-T5 has a colour of its own) with trained rank, banked xp, the training price and whether they are locked. Tokens: every tier in every realm. Market: the open token exchanges. Recipes: the catalogue by building ('crafthud recipes <building>' prints one). Raw: anything that has arrived non-empty and is not understood yet, under the server's own names - the system is days old and most of its lists have only ever been seen empty. 'crafthud' prints the Status page. Reads the feed; the only commands it can cause are the ones you click: a building's name (cbuild info, and build or upgrade from its right-click menu) and a skill's name (chelp, and ctrain from its right-click menu). Built from four captures (Keyser, 16-17 Nov 2026).
